column3: The timeline unpins only on a scroll more than 1px up, anchors on the deepest element at the top of the view (elementFromPoint), and re-marks instead of shifting when the browser clamped the position
column4: XIN-32: with native anchoring off, a scrollTop read 1px under the one toEnd set, while content had grown past the 32px end band, unpinned a live view; holdAnchor then applied a window reset's whole movement. Anchoring on a whole item missed growth inside it above the view, and scanning items per scroll event grew with item count
column5: New e2e: pinned with a 1px-short read plus growth stays pinned (fails at 90d81fe0, about 363px from the end); growth inside the spanning item holds (fails at 90d81fe0 by 120px); mutation runs: removing holdAnchor fails 2 tests, removing the tolerance fails 1; the Math.round calls and overflow-anchor:auto are not detectable in headless Chromium, whose scrollTop writes snap to whole pixels at device scale 1 and 2
